Temporally ordered pre-training yields improved factual freshness, while shuffled pre-training peaks on older data, possibly due to increased factual repetition. These findings, along with the release of our code at https://github.com/kyutai-labs/kairos , checkpoints, and datasets at https://huggingface.co/collections/kyutai/kairos provide a foundation for future research on continual learning for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了预训练数据顺序对大语言模型时间敏感事实知识获取的影响，通过在时间排序的Common Crawl数据上训练60亿参数模型，发现时间有序训练能提升知识时效性和时间精确性，同时保持通用语言理解能力不下降。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型通常在打乱语料上训练，导致模型知识冻结在训练时刻，时间感知能力不明。作者希望探究预训练数据顺序如何影响模型对时间敏感事实知识的获取。
AI.method: 构建包含7000多个时间敏感问题的基准测试集和评估协议；在时间排序的Common Crawl快照上训练60亿参数模型，与标准打乱预训练方式进行对比。
AI.result: 时间顺序训练的模型在通用语言理解和常识知识上与打乱基线持平，但知识更新程度更高、时间精度更准确。打乱预训练在旧数据上表现更好，可能是因为事实重复更多。
AI.conclusion: 时间有序预训练能提升知识时效性和时间精确性，为LLM的持续学习研究奠定了基础。

title: EventGait: Towards Robust Gait Recognition with Event Streams
summary: Gait recognition enables non-intrusive, privacy-preserving identification but suffers in uncontrolled environments due to illumination and motion sensitivity of conventional cameras. In this work, we explore gait recognition using event cameras, which offer microsecond temporal resolution and high dynamic range, naturally capturing robust dynamic cues and suppressing static noise. Existing event-based approaches typically aggregate event streams into event images over long time windows, thereby discarding fine-grained motion dynamics critical for gait recognition. Therefore, we propose \textbf{EventGait}, an end-to-end dual-stream framework that separately models motion and shape while preserving the advantages of events. Our dynamic stream leverages a Mixture of Spiking Experts (MoSE) with diverse neuron constants for robust dynamic perception across complex motion and illumination scenes, while the static stream learns dense shape representations via Cross-modal Structure Alignment (CroSA) with large vision foundation models. To address the absence of large-scale event-based gait datasets, we introduce a synthesis pipeline and release two new benchmarks: SUSTech1K-E and CCGR-Mini-E. Extensive experiments have shown that event-based gait recognition not only achieves results comparable to camera-based gait recognition under normal conditions but also significantly outperforms it in low-light scenarios. Our approach sets a new state of the art on both synthesized and real-world event-based gait benchmarks, highlighting the robustness and potential of event-driven gait analysis. The code and datasets are released at https://github.com/QUEAHREN/EventGait.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EventGait，一种基于事件相机的双流框架步态识别方法，通过动态流（混合脉冲专家MoSE）和静态流（跨模态结构对齐CroSA）分别建模运动与形状，在合成和真实事件步态基准上达到SOTA，尤其在低光场景下显著优于传统相机方法。
AI.motivation: 传统步态识别在非受控环境中受光照和运动敏感度影响，而事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率和宽动态范围，能自然捕捉鲁棒动态信息。现有事件方法通过长时窗汇聚事件流，丢失了细粒度运动动态，因此需要一种能同时保留事件优势并精细建模运动与形状的框架。
AI.method: 提出EventGait，一个端到端双流框架：1) 动态流采用混合脉冲专家（MoSE），使用多种神经元常数以适应复杂运动和光照下的动态感知；2) 静态流通过跨模态结构对齐（CroSA）与大视觉基础模型学习密集形状表征。同时构建了合成管线并发布了SUSTech1K-E和CCGR-Mini-E两个新基准数据集。
AI.result: 在合成和真实事件步态基准上均达到SOTA；在正常条件下与基于相机的步态识别性能相当，在低光场景下显著超越传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机步态识别在鲁棒性和潜力方面表现突出，EventGait框架有效解决了现有方法的局限性，为事件驱动步态分析开辟了新路径。

title: Beyond the Org Chart: AI and the Transformation of Invisible Work
summary: An increasing number of news and research articles report that AI adoption is allowing professionals to blur and extend the boundaries of their corporate roles. With the goal of understanding how work processes might be changing in an AI-forward company, we interviewed 24 product-focused individuals at a large technology firm about how AI has impacted their own work, their work within their product team, and their professional interactions. Our conversations suggest that AI is not only changing formal role responsibilities and collaborations between those roles, but also changing informal cultural practices like professional mentoring that are key to helping professionals settle in their positions, stay engaged with their work, and grow their careers. Some of these changes are positive, such as smoother collaboration between peers, but other changes are more nuanced and put the typical career growth opportunities, like receiving feedback from professional networks and promoting leadership and mentorship, at risk. We propose steps that AI companies can take to make the invisible work more visible. Additionally, we propose efforts that individuals and leaders can take to support their colleagues through AI transformation while preserving healthy company cultures that support diverse thinking, collaboration, and informal interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对一家大型科技公司24名产品导向员工的访谈，探讨了AI如何改变正式角色职责、团队协作以及非正式文化实践（如职业指导），并提出了使隐性工作显性化及维护健康公司文化的建议。
AI.motivation: 理解AI在AI前沿公司中如何影响工作流程、角色边界以及非正式文化实践（如职业指导）。
AI.method: 对一家大型科技公司24名产品导向员工进行半结构化访谈，收集关于AI对个人工作、团队协作及职业互动影响的定性数据。
AI.result: AI既带来了积极的协作变化，也带来了职业发展机会（如反馈、指导、领导力培养）受损的风险。
AI.conclusion: 建议AI公司采取措施使隐性工作显性化，并呼吁个人和领导者通过AI转型支持同事，维护健康的公司文化。

title: Reducing Political Manipulation with Consistency Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic political bias across a variety of sensitive contexts. We find that LLMs handle counterpart topics from opposing political sides asymmetrically. We refer to this phenomenon as covert political bias and identify 7 categories of techniques through which it operates. We propose two metrics for covert bias: Sentiment Consistency measures symmetry in rhetoric and framing across paired political prompts; Helpfulness Consistency measures symmetric depth and engagement. To reduce both types of covert bias, we introduce Political Consistency Training (PCT), an RL training method with two complementary paradigms: Sentiment Consistency Training and Helpfulness Consistency Training. We show that PCT preserves overall helpfulness, substantially reduces covert political bias, and generalizes to held-out benchmarks. We release our work at https://political-manipulation.ai

AI.tldr: LLMs存在隐性政治偏见，表现为对对立政治话题的不对称处理。本文提出情感一致性和帮助一致性两个指标，并引入政治一致性训练（PCT）来减少这种偏见。
AI.motivation: LLMs在敏感语境中表现出系统性政治偏见，特别是对对立政治话题的处理存在不对称性，这种隐性偏见需要被识别和缓解。
AI.method: 提出情感一致性训练和帮助一致性训练两种互补范式的政治一致性训练（PCT），采用强化学习方法来减少隐性政治偏见。
AI.result: PCT在保持整体帮助性的同时，显著减少了隐性政治偏见，并能泛化到未见过的基准测试中。
AI.conclusion: PCT有效降低了LLMs的隐性政治偏见，且不损害模型的整体帮助性，具有良好的泛化能力。

title: One Sentence, One Drama: Personalized Short-Form Drama Generation via Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Existing approaches for digital short-drama production typically rely on one-shot LLM generated scripts and loosely coupled pipelines, which fail to satisfy three key requirements of short-drama generation: (1) narrative pacing, resulting in weak hooks, insufficient escalation, and unattractive endings; (2) spatial consistency, leading to drifting scene layouts and inconsistent character positions across clips; and (3) production-level quality control, requiring extensive manual review and correction across script and visual stages. We present One Sentence, One Drama, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that transforms a user's single-sentence idea into a fully produced short drama through structured intermediate modules and iterative refinement. Our approach is built upon three key components: (1) a multi-agent debate-based story generation module that enforces short-drama pacing and narrative coherence; (2) a 3D-grounded first-frame generation mechanism that establishes a shared spatial reference for consistent character positioning and scene layout across clips; and (3) multi-stage reviewer loops that perform comprehensive error detection and targeted revision across script, visual, and video generation stages. We also introduce scene-level BGM matching and scene transition planning to improve the audience's immersive experience. To systematically evaluate this task, we introduce Short-Drama-Bench, a benchmark that extends standard video quality metrics with short-drama-specific criteria. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing pipelines in narrative quality, cross-clip consistency, and overall viewing experience.

AI.tldr: 提出"一句一剧"分层多智能体框架，将单句创意转化为完整短剧，显著优于现有流水线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数字短剧生产依赖一次性LLM生成脚本和松散耦合流水线，无法满足叙事节奏、空间一致性和制作级质量控制三大关键需求。
AI.method: 基于三个核心组件：(1)多智能体辩论故事生成模块，保障短剧节奏与叙事连贯性；(2)3D锚定的首帧生成机制，建立统一空间参考；(3)多阶段审稿循环，跨脚本、视觉、视频生成阶段进行错误检测与修订。还引入了场景级BGM匹配和场景过渡规划。
AI.result: 在自建Short-Drama-Bench基准上，该方法在叙事质量、跨片段一致性和整体观看体验上显著优于现有流水线。
AI.conclusion: 分层多智能体框架结合迭代精炼，能有效解决短剧生成中的叙事节奏、空间一致性和质量控制问题，提升沉浸式体验。

title: AMEL: Accumulated Message Effects on LLM Judgments
comment: 19 pages, 14 figures, 6 tables. Single author. Code, data (75,898 deduplicated API responses), and analysis pipeline at https://github.com/chutapp/amel
summary:
Large language models are routinely used as automated evaluators: to review code, moderate content, or score outputs, often with many items passing through one conversation. We ask whether the polarity of prior conversation history biases subsequent judgments, an effect we call the accumulated message effect on LLM judgments (AMEL). Across 75,898 API calls to 11 models from 4 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and four open-source models), we present identical test items in isolation or following histories saturated with predominantly positive or negative evaluations.
  Models shift toward the conversation's prevailing polarity (d = -0.17, p < 10^-46). The effect concentrates on items where the model is genuinely uncertain at baseline (d = -0.34 for high-entropy items, vs d = -0.15 when the baseline is deterministic). Bias does not grow with context length: 5 prior turns and 50 produce the same shift (Spearman |r| < 0.01; OLS slope p = 0.80). And there is a negativity asymmetry: paired per item, negative histories induce 1.62x more bias than positive (t = 13.46, p < 10^-39, n = 2,481). Scaling helps but does not solve it (Anthropic: Haiku -0.22 to Opus -0.17; OpenAI: Nano -0.34 to GPT-5.2 -0.17).
  Three follow-ups narrow the mechanism. The token probability distribution shifts continuously, not at a threshold. The negativity asymmetry has both token-level and semantic components, though attributing the balance is exploratory at our sample sizes. Position does not matter: five biased turns anywhere in a 50-turn history produce the same shift. The simplest fix for evaluation pipelines is a fresh context per item; when batching is unavoidable, balancing the history helps.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了对话历史极性（正面/负面）对LLM后续判断的累积偏差效应（AMEL），发现模型会偏向历史主导极性，负面历史影响更大，不确定性越高偏差越强，但偏差不随上下文长度增长。建议评估时使用独立上下文或平衡历史。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常被用作自动评估工具（如代码审查、内容审核、评分输出），但同一对话中连续评估多个项目时，先前的评估极性可能会偏差后续判断。现有研究对LLM在对话历史中累积偏差的关注不足，本文旨在系统量化这一效应并探索其机制。
AI.method: 对11个模型（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及4个开源模型）进行了75,898次API调用，将相同的测试项分别置于隔离环境、正面饱和历史或负面饱和历史中呈现，通过统计检验比较判断差异，并进一步通过三项后续实验（token概率分布、正负不对称来源、位置效应）探究机制。
AI.result: 模型判断显著向对话历史主导极性偏移（d=-0.17, p<10^-46），不确定性高的项目偏差更大（d=-0.34 vs -0.15）；负面历史影响是正面的1.62倍；偏差不随上下文长度增加（5轮vs50轮效果一致）；模型规模扩大可缓解但无法消除偏差。
AI.conclusion: 对话历史极性会系统性偏差LLM的判断，负面对话历史影响更大。最有效的缓解方案是每个项目使用独立上下文；必须批量处理时，平衡历史中的正负面评价有助于减少偏差。

title: Flow-based Gaussian Splatting for Continuous-Scale Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution
summary: High-resolution remote sensing images (RSIs) are crucial for Earth observation applications, yet acquiring them is often limited by sensor constraints and costs. In recent years, generative super-resolution (SR) methods, particularly diffusion models, have made significant progress. However, they typically require slow iterative inference with 40--1000 steps and exhibit limited flexibility in continuous-scale SR settings. To address these issues, we propose FlowGS, a generative reconstruction framework for arbitrary-scale SR of RSIs. FlowGS models the high-frequency detail representations between high- and low-resolution images and learns a continuous probability flow from noise to detail priors via flow matching (FM) constrained by shortcut consistency, thereby reducing generative complexity and improving inference efficiency. Additionally, we employ 2D Gaussian splatting to construct a continuous feature field, thereby enabling flexible reconstruction at arbitrary query locations. Experimental results show that FlowGS delivers competitive perceptual quality compared with existing methods in both continuous-scale and fixed-scale SR settings, with substantially improved inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: FlowGS是一种基于流匹配和2D高斯溅射的生成式超分辨率框架，能够高效、灵活地实现遥感图像的任意尺度超分辨率重建。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的超分辨率方法推理速度慢（需40-1000步迭代），且难以灵活支持连续尺度超分辨率，限制了遥感图像的实际应用。
AI.method: FlowGS通过流匹配（Flow Matching）建模高低分辨率图像间的高频细节表示，并引入快捷一致性约束（shortcut consistency）学习从噪声到细节先验的连续概率流，降低生成复杂度、提升推理效率；同时采用2D高斯溅射构建连续特征场，实现任意查询位置的灵活重建。
AI.result: 在连续尺度和固定尺度超分辨率设置下，FlowGS均达到了与现有方法相当的感知质量，且推理效率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: FlowGS为解决遥感图像超分辨率中推理效率低和尺度灵活性不足的问题提供了一种有效的生成式重建方案。

title: Parametric Modular Answer Set Programs Made Declarative
comment: To appear in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming
summary: In this paper, we explore the concept of modularity in first-order answer set programming (ASP). We introduce a new formalism called parametric modular logic programs, which allows defining subprograms with parameters and intensionality statements. We demonstrate how this formalism can capture the semantics of clingo-programs with collective control, a feature that enables structuring and instantiating subprograms. We provide theoretical foundations for modular ASP, illustrate its usefulness, and connect to traditional non-modular ASP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数化模块逻辑程序形式化方法，将模块化引入一阶回答集编程（ASP），通过带参数和内涵声明的子程序定义，捕捉了clingo程序的集体控制语义，为模块化ASP提供了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有ASP缺乏模块化支持，难以对复杂程序进行结构化和复用，因此需要将模块化概念引入一阶ASP中。
AI.method: 提出参数化模块逻辑程序（parametric modular logic programs），允许定义带参数和内涵声明的子程序，以此捕捉clingo-programs的集体控制语义。
AI.result: 成功建立了模块化ASP的理论基础，展示了其实用性，并与传统非模块化ASP建立了联系。
AI.conclusion: 参数化模块逻辑程序为ASP提供了有效的模块化机制，有助于复杂程序的构建和复用。

title: Tokenisation via Convex Relaxations
summary: Tokenisation is an integral part of the current NLP pipeline. Current tokenisation algorithms such as BPE and Unigram are greedy algorithms -- they make locally optimal decisions without considering the resulting vocabulary as a whole. We instead formulate tokeniser construction as a linear program and solve it using convex optimisation tools, yielding a new algorithm we call ConvexTok. We find ConvexTok consistently improves intrinsic tokenisation metrics and the bits-per-byte (BpB) achieved by language models; it also improves downstream task performance, but less consistently. Furthermore, ConvexTok allows the user to certify how far their tokeniser is from optimal, with respect to a certain objective, via a lower bound, and we empirically find it to be within 1\% of optimal at common vocabulary sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ConvexTok的新型分词算法，将分词器构建形式化为线性规划并使用凸优化工具求解，相比传统贪心算法在内在指标、语言模型BpB和下游任务上表现更优，且能证明分词器与最优解的差距在1%以内。
AI.motivation: 当前主流分词算法（如BPE、Unigram）是贪心算法，只做局部最优决策而不考虑整体词汇表质量，缺乏全局最优性保证。
AI.method: 将分词器构建形式化为线性规划问题，利用凸优化工具求解，得到新算法ConvexTok。
AI.result: ConvexTok稳定提升了内在分词指标和语言模型的bits-per-byte（BpB），在下游任务上也有提升但不那么稳定；经验上分词器与最优解的差距在1%以内。
AI.conclusion: ConvexTok提供了一种可认证最优性的分词方法，能在常见词汇表大小下保证接近最优的性能。

title: Balancing Uncertainty and Diversity of Samples: Leveraging Diversity of Least, High Confidence Samples for Effective Active Learning
summary: Deep learning models, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs), have achieved state-of-the-art performance on various computer vision tasks such as object classification, detection, segmentation, generation, and many more. However, these models are data-hungry as they require more training data to learn millions or billions of parameters. Especially for supervised learning tasks, curating a large number of labeled samples for model training is an expensive and time-consuming task. Active Learning (AL) has been used to address this problem for many years. Existing active learning methods aim at choosing the samples for annotation from a pool of unlabeled samples that are either diverse or uncertain. Choosing such samples may hinder the model's performance as we pool based on one dimension, i.e., either diverse or uncertain. In this paper, we propose four novel hybrid sampling methods for pooling both easy and hard samples, which are also diverse. To verify the efficacy of the proposed methods, extensive experiments are conducted using high and low-confidence samples separately. We observe from our experiments that the proposed hybrid sampling method, Least Confident and Diverse (LCD), consistently performs better compared to state-of-the-art methods. It is observed that selecting uncertain and diverse instances helps the model learn more distinct features. The codes related to this study will be available at https://github.com/XXX/LCD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出四种新型混合主动学习采样方法，其中LCD（最低置信度+多样性）方法在多次实验中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有主动学习采样方法仅基于单一维度（多样性或不确定性）选择样本，可能限制模型性能。本文旨在结合两个维度，提出混合采样策略。
AI.method: 提出四种混合采样方法，同时考虑样本的难易程度（高/低置信度）和多样性，核心方法是LCD（Least Confident and Diverse）。
AI.result: 实验表明，LCD方法在高低置信度样本上均优于现有方法，选择不确定且多样的样本有助于模型学习更独特的特征。
AI.conclusion: 混合采样策略（结合不确定性与多样性）能更有效地提升主动学习性能，LCD方法为最佳方案。

title: Can AI Make Conflicts Worse? An Alignment Failure in LLM Deployment Across Conflict Contexts
comment: Preprint. 8 pages, 2 figures. Code and evaluation framework: https://github.com/akryshtal/conflict-sensitivity-eval-bloom
summary: AI models are already deployed in societies affected by armed conflict, and journalists, humanitarian workers, governments and ordinary citizens rely on them for information or for their work processes. No established practice exists for checking whether their outputs can make those conflicts worse. We tested nine model configurations from four providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, xAI) on 90 multi-turn scenarios designed to surface misaligned behaviour in conflict contexts: false equivalence between documented atrocities, denial of genocide, and failure to recognise ethnic slurs, among others. When such outputs feed into journalism, humanitarian reporting, or public debate, they can deepen divisions in fragile societies. Failure rates span 6\% to 47\% between the best and worst performing models, which makes model choice a safety question in its own right and when users pushed for ``balance'' in cases where international courts have already assigned responsibility, five of nine configurations failed 80 to 100 percent of the time. We release the first evaluation framework for this domain and propose adding it to alignment evaluation portfolios.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试了来自四家AI提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、xAI）的九种模型配置在武装冲突场景中的表现，发现模型输出存在虚假对等、否认种族灭绝等不当行为，失败率从6%到47%不等，当用户要求"平衡"时，五分之九的配置失败率达80-100%。研究首次发布了该领域的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏评估AI模型在武装冲突情境中是否加剧冲突的实践方法，而AI模型已被部署在受冲突影响的社会中，其输出可能加深社会分裂。
AI.method: 测试了来自OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、xAI的九种模型配置，使用90个多轮对话场景，检测虚假对等、否认种族灭绝、未能识别种族侮辱等不当行为。
AI.result: 模型失败率在6%到47%之间；当用户要求"平衡"时，五分之九的配置在80-100%的情况下失败。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择本身就是一个安全问题，研究首次发布了该领域的评估框架，并建议将其纳入对齐评估体系。

title: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models for Safety-Critical Driving Video Analysis
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026)
summary: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in general visual understanding. However, their application to safety-critical driving scenarios remains limited by an inability to accurately perceive and reason about rare high-stakes dynamic events, such as collisions or near-collisions. To address this, we introduce a pipeline that enhances MLLM perception by fusing downsampled video frames with synchronized high-frequency telematics data (IMU and GPS) and semantic insights from specialized computer vision models. Our pipeline generates high-quality pseudo-labels, including descriptive captions and question-answer pairs, specifically designed to train MLLMs to identify and describe Safety-Critical Events (SCEs) in real-world driving footage. We show the effectiveness of our approach fine-tuning the open-source QwenVL-2.5 model via DoRA adapters: our experiments demonstrate significant improvements in identifying and explaining safety-critical events, with fewer than 50M trainable parameters and limited computational budget.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种融合视频、遥测数据和语义信息的多模态管道，通过生成高质量伪标签微调MLLM，以不到50M参数实现驾驶安全关键事件的准确识别与描述。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在通用视觉理解上表现出色，但在安全关键的驾驶场景中，对碰撞等罕见高风险动态事件的感知和推理能力不足。
AI.method: 1) 融合下采样视频帧、高频IMU/GPS遥测数据和专业CV模型的语义信息；2) 生成包含描述性字幕和问答对的高质量伪标签；3) 使用DoRA适配器微调QwenVL-2.5模型。
AI.result: 在识别和解释安全关键事件上显著提升，仅需不到50M可训练参数和有限的计算预算。
AI.conclusion: 所提多模态融合管道能有效增强MLLM对驾驶安全关键事件的感知能力，且计算开销低。

title: Event-Illumination Collaborative Low-light Image Enhancement with a High-resolution Real-world Dataset
summary: Event-based low-light image enhancement (LIE) methods mainly focus on incorporating high dynamic range (HDR) information from events while overlooking the essential global illumination in images and the inherent noise sensitivity of event signals in real-world scenarios. To address these issues, we propose EIC-LIE, an event-illumination collaborative LIE framework. Concretely, we first design an Event-Illumination Collaborative Interaction (EICI) module, which contains two key processes: forward gathering, which gathers HDR features across varying lighting conditions, and backward injection, which provides complementary content for illumination and event representations. Next, we introduce an Illumination-aware Event Filter (IAEF) that dynamically reduces event noise based on brightness statistics derived from images. Additionally, we build a beam-splitter-based hybrid imaging system to collect high-quality event-image pairs with temporal synchronization from dynamic scenes, providing the first high-resolution, real-world event-based LIE dataset. Extensive experiments show that our EIC-LIE outperforms state-of-the-art methods on five real-world and synthetic datasets, significantly surpassing previous methods with improvements of up to 1.24dB in PSNR and 0.069 in SSIM. The code and dataset are released at https://github.com/QUEAHREN/EIC-LIE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EIC-LIE框架，通过事件-光照协同交互模块和光照感知事件滤波器，在低光图像增强任务中融合事件的高动态范围信息并抑制噪声，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于事件的低光图像增强方法主要关注融合事件的高动态范围信息，但忽略了图像中全局光照信息以及真实场景中事件信号固有的噪声敏感性。
AI.method: 1) 事件-光照协同交互模块(EICI)，包含前向聚集和后向注入两个过程；2) 光照感知事件滤波器(IAEF)，根据图像亮度统计动态降低事件噪声；3) 构建了基于分束器的混合成像系统，收集高质量事件-图像对数据集。
AI.result: 在五个真实和合成数据集上，PSNR提升最高达1.24dB，SSIM提升最高达0.069，超越现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 事件-光照协同机制有效提升了低光图像增强性能，且公开了代码和数据集。

title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
summary: While ubiquitous wearable sensors capture a wealth of behavioral and physiological information, effectively transforming these signals into personalized health insights is challenging. Specifically, converting low-level sensor data into representations capable of characterizing higher-level states is difficult due to high phenotypic diversity and variation in individual baseline health, physiology, and lifestyle factors. Moreover, collecting wearable data paired with health outcome annotations is laborious and expensive, and retrospective annotation remains practically unfeasible, contributing to a scarcity of data with high-quality labels. To overcome these limitations, we propose a foundation model for wearable health that is pretrained on more than one trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals drawn from a large cohort of five million participants. We demonstrate that the joint scaling of model capacity and pretraining data volume leads to systematic improvements in performance, as evaluated on a diverse set of 35 health prediction tasks, spanning cardiovascular, metabolic, sleep, and mental health, as well as lifestyle choices and demographic factors. We find that this population scale representation unlocks label-efficient few-shot learning and generative capabilities for robust daily metric estimation. To further leverage this learned representation, we deploy a classroom of LLM agents to autonomously search the space of downstream predictive heads built on the model embeddings, showing broad performance improvements that increase with LLM model capacity. Finally, we show how integrating these downstream predictors into a Personal Health Agent can support model responses that are more relevant, contextually aware, and safe, and we validate this via 1,860 ratings from a cohort of clinicians.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于超过1万亿分钟、500万参与者未标注可穿戴传感器数据的健康基础模型，在35项健康预测任务上展现优异性能，并通过LLM智能体与个人健康代理实现临床级健康洞察。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴传感器数据转化为个性化健康洞察面临两大挑战：表型多样性与个体基线差异导致低层信号难以表征高层健康状态；标注数据稀缺且收集成本高。
AI.method: 在大规模（5百万参与者、1万亿+分钟）未标注可穿戴信号上预训练基础模型；联合扩展模型容量与数据量；部署LLM智能体教室自动搜索下游预测头；构建个人健康代理（Personal Health Agent）。
AI.result: 在35项健康预测任务（心血管、代谢、睡眠、心理健康、生活方式、人口统计）上展现系统性性能提升；实现标签高效的小样本学习与鲁棒日度指标估计；LLM智能体带来广泛性能提升；临床医生1,860次评分验证了模型的相关性、上下文感知能力与安全性。
AI.conclusion: 大规模预训练的可穿戴基础模型结合LLM驱动的下游预测，能够有效克服数据稀缺与个体差异问题，为个性化健康洞察提供可扩展、安全可靠的解决方案。

title: Ultra-High-Definition Image Quality Assessment via Graph Representation Learning
summary: Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) for ultrahighdefinition (UHD) images remains challenging because native-resolution inference is computationally expensive, whereas aggressive resizing or isolated cropping may suppress scale-sensitive distortions and weaken the relationship between local artifacts and global scene context. This paper aims to improve UHD-BIQA by explicitly modeling the structural dependencies among sampled image regions rather than treating them as independent views, and a graph representation learning framework UHD-GCN-BIQA is proposed. The framework samples aspect-ratio-aligned patches from each UHD image, encodes them as graph nodes, and constructs a hybrid k-nearest-neighbor graph using spatial proximity and feature similarity. Residual graph convolution is used to propagate contextual information across regions, and gated attention pooling aggregates patchlevel evidence into an imagelevel quality prediction. An exponential moving average normalized multiobjective loss function is adopted to stabilize the joint optimization of regression, correlation, and ranking objectives. Experiments on the UHD-IQA benchmark show that UHD-GCN-BIQA achieves PLCC = 0.7784, SRCC = 0.8019, and RMSE = 0.0519, obtaining competitive correlation performance and the lowest RMSE among the compared methods. These results indicate that graph-based region relation modeling is effective for UHD image quality assessment, particularly for improving absolute quality score estimation under high-resolution visual content.

AI.tldr: 提出UHD-GCN-BIQA框架，通过图表示学习建模超高清图像中采样区域间的结构依赖关系，而非将区域视为独立视图，在UHD-IQA基准上取得有竞争力的性能（PLCC=0.7784, SRCC=0.8019, RMSE=0.0519）。
AI.motivation: 超高清图像盲质量评估面临计算成本高、缩放或裁剪会抑制尺度敏感失真、破坏局部与全局上下文关系等挑战，现有方法将采样区域视为独立视图，缺乏对区域间结构依赖关系的显式建模。
AI.method: 从UHD图像中采样保持宽高比的图像块作为图节点，构建融合空间邻近度和特征相似度的混合k近邻图，通过残差图卷积传播区域间上下文信息，采用门控注意力池化将块级证据聚合为图像级质量预测，并设计指数移动平均归一化多目标损失函数联合优化回归、相关和排序目标。
AI.result: 在UHD-IQA基准上，PLCC=0.7784，SRCC=0.8019，RMSE=0.0519，相关性性能具有竞争力，RMSE在所有对比方法中最低。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的区域关系建模对超高清图像质量评估有效，尤其在提升高分辨率视觉内容下的绝对质量分数估计准确性方面表现出色。

title: Advancing Mathematics Research with AI-Driven Formal Proof Search
comment: The first three authors and the last author have equal contributions. The first three authors are in random order
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly excel at mathematical reasoning, but their unreliability limits their utility in mathematics research. A mitigation is using LLMs to generate formal proofs in languages like Lean. We perform the first large-scale evaluation of this method's ability to solve open problems. Our most capable agent autonomously resolved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems at the per-problem cost of a few hundred dollars, proved 44/492 OEIS conjectures, and is being deployed in combinatorics, optimization, graph theory, algebraic geometry, and quantum optics research. A basic agent alternating LLM-based generation with Lean-based verification replicated the Erdős successes but proved costlier on the hardest problems. These findings demonstrate the power of AI-aided formal proof search and shed light on the agent designs that enable it.

AI.tldr: 本文首次大规模评估了使用LLM生成形式化证明（Lean语言）来解决开放数学问题的能力，最强大的智能体以数百美元的成本解决了353个开放Erdős问题中的9个、492个OEIS猜想中的44个，并在多个数学领域得到应用。基础智能体通过交替LLM生成与Lean验证复现了Erdős上的成功，但在最难问题上成本更高。
AI.motivation: LLM在数学推理中表现日益出色，但不可靠性限制了其在数学研究中的应用。通过LLM生成形式化证明（如Lean语言）是一种缓解方案，但此前缺乏大规模评估该方法解决开放问题能力的研究。
AI.method: 使用最强大的智能体（自主解决）和基础智能体（交替LLM生成与Lean验证）两种设计，在353个开放Erdős问题和492个OEIS猜想上进行大规模评估，比较不同代理设计在解决开放数学问题上的效果和成本。
AI.result: 最强大的智能体自主解决了9/353个开放Erdős问题（每问题成本数百美元）和44/492个OEIS猜想，已在组合学、优化、图论、代数几何和量子光学研究中部署。基础智能体复现了Erdős上的成功，但在最难问题上成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了AI辅助形式化证明搜索的强大能力，并揭示了实现这一能力的智能体设计特征。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling with Random Job Arrivals
summary: The Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) is the optimal allocation of a set of jobs to machines. Two primary challenges persist in FJSP: the unpredictable arrival of future jobs and the combinatorial complexity of the problem, rendering it intractable for conventional mixed-integer linear programming solvers. This paper proposes an event-based \gls{DRL} approach to solve FJSP with random job arrivals. Specifically, we employ the Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm and use lightweight Multi-Layer Perceptrons to train the \gls{DRL} agent for minimizing the total completion time of all jobs. We design the state representation to be directly accessible from the environment, and limit the learning agent to selecting from among a set of well-established dispatching rules. Simulations show that our \gls{DRL} approach outperforms any of the individual dispatching rules on datasets with varying heterogeneity and job arrival rates. We benchmark our \gls{DRL} against an arrival-triggered mixed-integer linear programming solution and show that our method achieves good performance especially when the datasets are heterogeneous.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于事件驱动深度强化学习的方法来解决具有随机任务到达的柔性作业车间调度问题，通过近端策略优化算法和轻量级多层感知机训练智能体，在异构数据集上优于传统调度规则和混合整数线性规划方法。
AI.motivation: 柔性作业车间调度问题面临两个主要挑战：未来任务的不可预测到达以及问题的组合复杂性，使得传统混合整数线性规划求解器难以处理。
AI.method: 采用事件驱动的深度强化学习方法，使用近端策略优化算法和轻量级多层感知机训练智能体；状态表示直接从环境中获取，智能体从一组成熟的调度规则中选择动作。
AI.result: DRL方法在具有不同异构性和任务到达率的数据集上，优于任何单一调度规则；在异构数据集上，该方法性能优于触发式混合整数线性规划求解方案。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动的深度强化学习方法能有效解决随机任务到达的FJSP问题，尤其在异构数据集上表现良好，为实际生产调度提供了可行方案。

title: Zero-Shot Temporal Action Localization Through Textual Guidance
summary: Zero-shot temporal action localization (ZS-TAL) consists of classifying and localizing actions in untrimmed videos, where action classes are unseen at training time. Existing work uses Vision and Language Models (VLMs), taking advantage of their strong zero-shot transfer capabilities. Yet, these models face evident challenges with fine-grained action classification, making it difficult to directly use them to distinguish between the presence and absence of an action. Most current methods for ZS-TAL address these challenges by training models on large-scale video datasets, which require annotated data and often result in limited generalization performance. Recently, approaches discarding the use of labeled data have emerged as an alternative. Following this direction, we propose a novel approach, ``Textual Guidance for finer localization of actions in videos'' (TEGU), that compensates for the lack of supervision from training data by exploiting rich textual information derived from large language models and structured text extracted from captions. This additional linguistic context can improve fine-grained discrimination by providing richer cues about fine-grained action differences within videos. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed method by conducting experiments on the THUMOS14 and the ActivityNet-v1.3 datasets. Our results show that, by exploiting rich textual information for improved action localization, TEGU outperforms state-of-the-art ZS-TAL approaches that do not involve training

AI.tldr: TEGU方法利用大语言模型和结构化文本增强零样本时序动作定位中的细粒度区分能力，无需标注数据即可超越现有无训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有ZS-TAL方法面临细粒度动作分类困难，且依赖大规模标注数据训练导致泛化性差；无训练方法虽出现但性能不足。
AI.method: 提出TEGU方法，通过大语言模型和视频字幕提取丰富的文本信息，为动作定位提供细粒度语义线索，弥补无监督条件下的信息缺失。
AI.result: 在THUMOS14和ActivityNet-v1.3上，TEGU超越现有所有无需训练的状态最优ZS-TAL方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用外部文本知识可有效提升零样本动作定位的细粒度判别能力，是避免标注依赖的有效途径。

title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on intermediate communication to coordinate complex tasks. While most existing systems communicate through natural language, recent work shows that latent communication, particularly through transformer key-value (KV) caches, can improve efficiency and preserve richer task-relevant information. However, KV caches also encode contextual inputs, intermediate reasoning states, and agent-specific information, creating an opaque channel through which sensitive content may propagate across agents without explicit textual disclosure. To address this, we introduce \textbf{LCGuard} (Latent Communication Guard), a framework for safe KV-based latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems. LCGuard treats shared KV caches as latent working memory and learns representation-level transformations before cache artifacts are transmitted across agents. We formalize representation-level sensitive information leakage operationally through reconstruction: a shared cache artifact is unsafe if an adversarial decoder can recover agent-specific sensitive inputs from it. This leads to an adversarial training formulation in which the adversary learns to reconstruct sensitive inputs, while LCGuard learns transformations that preserve task-relevant semantics and reduce reconstructable information. Empirical evaluations across multiple model families and multi-agent benchmarks show that LCGuard consistently reduces reconstruction-based leakage and attack success rates while maintaining competitive task performance compared to standard KV-sharing baselines.

AI.tldr: LCGuard是一个针对基于KV缓存的多Agent系统潜在通信的安全框架，通过对抗训练学习表征变换，在保持任务性能的同时减少敏感信息重构泄露。
AI.motivation: 多Agent系统中基于KV缓存的潜在通信虽然高效，但会编码敏感信息，形成不透明的泄露通道。现有方法缺乏对此类信息泄露的保护机制。
AI.method: 将共享KV缓存视为潜在工作记忆，通过对抗训练框架：攻击者学习重构敏感输入，LCGuard学习保留任务语义同时减少可重构信息的表征变换。
AI.result: 在多个模型系列和多Agent基准上，LCGuard持续降低基于重构的泄露和攻击成功率，同时保持与标准KV共享基线相当的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: LCGuard有效实现了KV缓存潜在通信中的隐私保护与任务性能之间的平衡，为多Agent系统安全通信提供了可行方案。

title: EvoIR-Agent: Self-Evolving Image Restoration Agentic System via Experience-Driven Learning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-driven image restoration agent demonstrates effectiveness in degradation coupling scenarios by flexibly selecting tools and determining removal orders. However, their zero-shot planning often fails without experience, necessitating severe trial-and-error overhead to achieve satisfactory outcomes. Currently, two paradigms are employed to address this issue, yet a dilemma persists: Training-based methods embed intrinsic experience into parameters, achieving high inference efficiency but lacking compatibility with new tools or degradation. In contrast, training-free methods utilize explicit experience storage for compatibility but still incur trial-and-error overhead due to naive experience. To resolve the dilemma, we propose EvoIR-Agent, which first systematically formulates the experience components of a training-free image restoration agent. Subsequently, a hierarchical experience pool is constructed, which enables coarse-to-fine guidance for diverse tools and removal orders. Furthermore, a self-evolving mechanism is introduced to update the pool from scratch using accumulated records, thereby greatly improving performance and efficiency. Extensive experiments reveal that EvoIR-Agent achieves a significant lead in the full reference metrics and yields a remarkable Pareto-optimal balance between performance and efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoIR-Agent，通过层次化经验池和自进化机制解决MLLM驱动的图像恢复智能体在零样本规划中经验不足和效率低下的问题，实现性能与效率的帕累托最优平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM驱动的图像恢复智能体在退化耦合场景中面临两难困境：基于训练的方法嵌入内隐经验，推理效率高但缺乏兼容性；基于无训练的方法使用外显经验存储具备兼容性，但因经验简单仍需试错开销。需要一种能同时兼顾兼容性和效率的方案。
AI.method: 1) 系统形式化定义了无训练图像恢复智能体的经验组件；2) 构建层次化经验池，实现从粗到细的多样化工具和移除顺序引导；3) 引入自进化机制，从零开始利用积累记录更新经验池。
AI.result: 在全参考指标上显著领先，与现有最优方法相比，实现了性能与效率的帕累托最优平衡。
AI.conclusion: EvoIR-Agent通过层次化经验池和自进化机制有效解决了无训练图像恢复智能体的经验不足问题，在不牺牲兼容性的前提下大幅提升性能和效率。

title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
comment: Gated DeltaNet-2 technical report; code at https://github.com/NVlabs/GatedDeltaNet-2
summary: Linear attention replaces the unbounded cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing sequence mixing to linear time and decoding to constant memory. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations. Delta-rule models subtract the current read before writing a new value, and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) sharpens forgetting with channel-wise decay. But the active edit still uses a single scalar gate to control two different things: how much old content to erase on the key side and how much new content to commit on the value side. We introduce Gated DeltaNet-2, which generalizes both Gated DeltaNet and KDA by inheriting adaptive forgetting and channel-wise decay while addressing their shared limitation, the scalar tie between erasing and writing. Gated Delta Rule-2 separates these roles with a channel-wise erase gate b_t and a channel-wise write gate w_t, reducing to KDA when both gates collapse to the same scalar and to Gated DeltaNet when the decay also collapses. We derive a fast-weight update view, a chunkwise WY algorithm with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors, and a gate-aware backward pass that preserves efficient parallel training. At 1.3B parameters trained on 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens, Gated DeltaNet-2 achieves the strongest overall results among Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet, KDA, and Mamba-3 variants across language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and retrieval. Its advantage is most pronounced on long-context RULER needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks, where it improves the evaluated multi-key retrieval setting and remains strong in both recurrent and hybrid settings. Code is available at https://github.com/NVlabs/GatedDeltaNet-2.

AI.tldr: Gated DeltaNet-2通过分离擦除和写入门控，解决了现有delta规则线性注意力模型中标量门控耦合的问题，在语言建模、推理和长上下文检索任务上取得了优于Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet、KDA等方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有delta规则线性注意力模型（如Gated DeltaNet和KDA）使用单一标量门控同时控制键侧擦除和值侧写入，导致两者耦合，限制了模型的表达能力和遗忘精度。
AI.method: 提出Gated DeltaNet-2，引入独立的逐通道擦除门b_t和逐通道写入门w_t，解耦了擦除和写入两个角色；推导了快速权重更新视角、吸收非对称擦除因子的分块WY算法以及门控感知的反向传播。
AI.result: 在1.3B参数、100B FineWeb-Edu tokens上训练，Gated DeltaNet-2在语言建模、常识推理和检索任务上全面优于Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet、KDA和Mamba-3变体；在长上下文RULER多键检索任务上优势最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 解耦擦除门和写入门能有效提升delta规则线性注意力模型的性能，特别是在长上下文多键检索场景下，同时保持高效的并行训练和推理。

title: GALAR-TemporalNet v2: Anatomy-Guided Dual-Branch Temporal Classification with Bidirectional Mamba and Dual-Graph GCN for Video Capsule Endoscopy -- after competition results
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Post-competition preprint for the ICPR 2026 RARE-VISION Challenge
summary: Video Capsule Endoscopy (VCE) poses a challenging multi-label temporal classification problem, requiring simultaneous localization of 8 anatomical regions and detection of 9 pathological findings across tens of thousands of frames. We present GALAR-TemporalNet v2, a hierarchical temporal model that addresses three core challenges: extreme class imbalance, long-range temporal dependencies, and pathology--anatomy entanglement. Our architecture combines windowed self-attention for local modeling, a Dual-Graph GCN for global frame relationships, and Bidirectional Mamba for selective boundary context encoding. A novel anatomy prototype residual pathway decouples pathological deviation signals from normal organ appearance, and a frame-level GCN skip connection stabilizes training of visually confusable rare classes. The competition version, GALAR-TemporalNet, achieved an overall mAP@0.5 of 0.2644 and mAP@0.95 of 0.2353 on the RARE-VISION test set. Following the competition, the redesigned GALAR-TemporalNet v2 -- incorporating a restructured pathology branch, refined loss functions, and extended post-processing -- improved these results to mAP@0.5 of 0.3409 and mAP@0.95 of 0.3333.

AI.tldr: 提出了GALAR-TemporalNet v2层次时序模型，通过窗口自注意力、双图GCN、双向Mamba及解剖原型残差路径等技术，解决了VCE中的类别不平衡、长程依赖和病理-解剖纠缠问题，在RARE-VISION测试集上取得了mAP@0.5为0.3409、mAP@0.95为0.3333的成绩。
AI.motivation: 视频胶囊内窥镜（VCE）面临多标签时序分类挑战，存在极端类别不平衡、长程时序依赖以及病理与解剖区域特征纠缠三大核心难题，现有方法难以同时准确定位8个解剖区域并检测9种病理发现。
AI.method: 提出GALAR-TemporalNet v2层次时序模型，包含：窗口级自注意力进行局部建模、双图图卷积网络捕获全局帧关系、双向Mamba选择性编码边界上下文；引入解剖原型残差路径分离病理偏差信号与正常器官外观，以及帧级GCN跳跃连接稳定易混淆稀有类别的训练。
AI.result: 竞赛版GALAR-TemporalNet在RARE-VISION测试集上mAP@0.5为0.2644、mAP@0.95为0.2353；改进后的v2版本（重构病理分支、优化损失函数、扩展后处理）将结果提升至mAP@0.5为0.3409、mAP@0.95为0.3333。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化时序建模和解剖-病理解耦设计，有效解决了VCE中的多标签时序分类难题，显著提升了检测精度。

title: MOSS: Self-Evolution through Source-Level Rewriting in Autonomous Agent Systems
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Preprint. Code: https://github.com/dav-joy-thon/MOSS
summary: Autonomous agentic systems are largely static after deployment: they do not learn from user interactions, and recurring failures persist until the next human-driven update ships a fix. Self-evolving agents have emerged in response, but all confine evolution to text-mutable artifacts -- skill files, prompt configurations, memory schemas, workflow graphs -- and leave the agent harness untouched. Since routing, hook ordering, state invariants, and dispatch live in code rather than in any text artifact, an entire class of structural failure is physically unreachable from the text layer. We argue that source-level adaptation is a fundamentally more general medium: it is Turing-complete, a strict superset of every text-mutable scope, takes effect deterministically rather than through base-model compliance, and does not erode under long-context drift. We present MOSS, a system that performs self-rewriting at the source level on production agentic substrates. Each evolution is anchored to an automatically curated batch of production-failure evidence and proceeds through a deterministic multi-stage pipeline; code modification is delegated to a pluggable external coding-agent CLI while MOSS retains stage ordering and verdicts. Candidates are verified by replaying the batch against the candidate image in ephemeral trial workers, then promoted via user-consent-gated, in-place container swap with health-probe-gated rollback. On OpenClaw, MOSS lifts a four-task mean grader score from 0.25 to 0.61 in a single cycle without human intervention.

AI.tldr: MOSS是一个能够在源代码层面进行自我演化的智能体系统，通过自动收集失败证据、多阶段确定性管道修改代码，并经过验证后安全部署，显著提升了任务表现（从0.25到0.61）。
AI.motivation: 现有自主智能体系统在部署后是静态的，无法从用户交互中学习，反复出现的故障只能等待人工更新修复。已有的自演化智能体仅局限于文本层（技能文件、提示配置、记忆模式等），无法触及代码层面的路由、钩子排序、状态不变量和调度等核心问题，导致一类结构性故障无法被修复。
AI.method: MOSS系统：1）自动批量化收集生产环境失败证据；2）通过确定性多阶段管道处理；3）代码修改委托给可插拔的外部编码智能体CLI，MOSS保留阶段排序和裁决权；4）在临时试运行工作节点上重放批处理进行候选验证；5）通过用户同意门控的就地容器替换（含健康检查门控的回滚机制）进行部署。
AI.result: 在OpenClaw上，MOSS在一个无需人工干预的周期内将四个任务的均值评分从0.25提升至0.61。
AI.conclusion: 源代码层适配是一种根本更通用的演化媒介——图灵完备、严格超集于文本可变范围、确定性生效而非依赖基础模型合规性、不会因长上下文漂移而退化。

title: REACH: Hand Pose Estimation from Room Corners
summary: We introduce a novel 3D hand pose estimator that can accurately recover the shape and pose of people's hands in a room from afar, typically from fixed cameras at room corners, in extremely low-resolution and frequently occluded views. Our key idea is to fully leverage hand-body coordination, its temporal progression, and multiview observations. We achieve this with a novel Transformer-based model, in which hand and body configurations are modeled through correlations between their visual features expressed as per-view tokens, and their temporal coordination is exploited in an autoregressive manner. We introduce a novel dataset, which we refer to as REACH, Room-Environment dataset Annotated with Chest cameras for Hand pose estimation, to train and test our method. REACH is a first-of-its-kind large-scale hand pose dataset that captures accurate hand movements of 50 participants across a wide variety of daily activities. In order to avoid interfering with natural movements while annotating the hands with accurate shape and pose, we leverage concealed chest cameras. Through extensive experiments, including comparative studies with existing methods, we show that our model, REACH-Net, achieves highly accurate 3D hand pose estimation from afar. These results broaden the horizon of 3D hand pose estimation, especially towards "in-the-wild" continuous human behavior analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的新型3D手部姿态估计方法REACH-Net，利用手-身体协调性、时间序列和多视角观察，从远距离低分辨率视频中准确恢复手部形状和姿态。同时发布了首个大规模远距离手部姿态数据集REACH，包含50位参与者的日常活动。
AI.motivation: 现有3D手部姿态估计方法大多针对近距离、高分辨率场景，难以应用于远距离、低分辨率、频繁遮挡的室内固定摄像头视角。本文旨在解决这一实际应用中的挑战。
AI.method: 提出REACH-Net，一种基于Transformer的模型，通过视点token表达手部与身体视觉特征的相关性，以自回归方式利用时序协调性。同时构建REACH数据集，使用隐蔽的胸部摄像头在不干扰自然运动的前提下标注准确的手部姿态。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，REACH-Net在远距离低分辨率场景下实现了高度准确的3D手部姿态估计，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓展了3D手部姿态估计的边界，尤其适用于"野外"连续人类行为分析场景。

title: SpaceDG: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence under Visual Degradation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in spatial intelligence, yet existing spatial reasoning benchmarks largely assume pristine visual inputs and overlook the degradations that commonly occur in real-world deployment, such as motion blur, low light, adverse weather, lens distortion, and compression artifacts. This raises a fundamental question: how robust is the spatial intelligence of current MLLMs when visual observations are imperfect? To answer this question, we introduce SpaceDG, the first large-scale dataset for degradation-aware spatial understanding. It is constructed with a physically grounded degradation synthesis engine that embeds degradation formation process into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering, enabling realistic simulation of nine degradation types. The resulting dataset contains approximately 1M QA pairs from nearly 1,000 indoor scenes. We further introduce SpaceDG-Bench, an human-verified benchmark with 1,102 questions spanning 11 reasoning categories and 9 visual degradation types, yielding over 10K VQA instances. Evaluating 25 open- and closed-source MLLMs reveals that visual degradations consistently and substantially impair spatial reasoning, exposing a critical robustness gap. Finally, we show that finetuning on SpaceDG markedly improves degradation robustness and can even surpass human performance under degraded conditions without any performance drop on clean images, highlighting the promise of degradation-aware training for robust spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个面向退化感知空间理解的基准数据集SpaceDG，系统评估了25个多模态大模型在9种视觉退化条件下的空间推理能力，发现视觉退化会显著损害空间推理，而基于该数据集的微调可提升模型鲁棒性甚至超越人类表现。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准大多假设理想视觉输入，忽视了实际部署中常见的运动模糊、低光照、恶劣天气、镜头畸变和压缩伪影等视觉退化问题。本文旨在回答：当视觉观测不完美时，当前多模态大模型的空间智能有多鲁棒？
AI.method: 提出了SpaceDG数据集，采用物理驱动的退化合成引擎，将退化形成过程嵌入3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）渲染中，模拟9种退化类型，覆盖近1000个室内场景，生成约100万QA对。并构建了人工验证的SpaceDG-Bench，包含1102个问题，涵盖11种推理类别和9种退化类型，总计超过1万个VQA实例。
AI.result: 评估了25个开源和闭源多模态大模型，发现视觉退化一致且显著地损害了空间推理能力，暴露了关键的鲁棒性差距。在SpaceDG上微调后，模型退化鲁棒性明显提升，甚至在退化条件下超越人类表现，且在干净图像上性能无下降。
AI.conclusion: 视觉退化是当前多模态大模型空间智能的主要短板，通过退化感知训练可有效提升鲁棒性，为实现稳健的空间智能提供了可行路径。

title: Direct content-based retrieval from music scores images
summary: The digitization of musical scores plays a crucial role in their preservation and accessibility, yet information retrieval still depends mainly on metadata searches, such as by title or composer. Content based search in music score images remains underexplored compared to text documents, despite its potential value for musicians, musicologists, and educators. This work contributes to the field by first studying which characteristics of a score are most relevant for search and by defining a systematic method to build query datasets from any annotated corpus. We also consider diverse methods for content-based search on music score images, ranging from transcription-based approaches relying on Optical Music Recognition (OMR), to a transcription-free Transformer model trained to recognize queries directly from score images, and a text-prompted Large Language Model. Our experiments evaluate these models on four corpora exhibiting diverse characteristics in terms of dataset size, image quality, and typesetting mechanisms. Overall, each method excels under different conditions: OMR-based pipelines achieve higher in-domain retrieval, whereas transcription-free models handle domain variability more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了乐谱数字图像的内容检索方法，比较了基于光学音乐识别（OMR）的转录方法、无需转录的Transformer模型以及基于文本提示的大语言模型在四种不同语料库上的表现。每种方法各有优劣：OMR在领域内检索更优，而无需转录的模型在跨领域变异性处理上更有效。
AI.motivation: 乐谱数字化对保存和访问至关重要，但当前检索主要依赖元数据（如标题、作曲家），基于乐谱图像内容的检索研究不足，而这对音乐家、音乐学家和教育者具有重要价值。
AI.method: 首先研究乐谱中哪些特征对检索最相关，并定义从任意标注语料库构建查询数据集的系统方法。然后比较三类方法：基于OMR的转录方法、无需转录的Transformer模型（直接从乐谱图像识别查询）、以及文本提示的大语言模型。
AI.result: 在四种不同特征（数据集大小、图像质量、排版机制）的语料库上评估发现：OMR方法在领域内检索表现更优，而无需转录的模型在应对领域变异性方面更有效。
AI.conclusion: 不同方法各有适用场景，OMR适合领域内高精度检索，无需转录模型更适合跨域泛化场景。

title: AnyMo: Geometry-Aware Setup-Agnostic Modeling of Human Motion in the Wild
summary: As wearable and mobile devices become increasingly embedded in daily life, they offer a practical way to continuously sense human motion in the wild. But inertial signals are highly dependent on the sensing setup, including body location, mounting position, sensor orientation, device hardware, and sampling protocol. This setup dependence makes it difficult to learn motion representations that transfer across devices and datasets, and limits the broader use of wearable IMUs beyond closed-set recognition. We introduce AnyMo, a geometry-aware framework for setup-agnostic human motion modeling. AnyMo uses physics-grounded IMU simulation over dense body-surface placements to generate diverse and plausible synthetic signals, pre-trains a graph encoder from paired synthetic placement views and masked partial observations, tokenizes multi-position IMU into full-body motion tokens, and aligns these tokens with an LLM for motion-language understanding. We evaluate AnyMo on three complementary tasks: zero-shot activity recognition across 14 unseen downstream datasets, cross-modal retrieval, and wearable IMU motion captioning, where it improves average Accuracy/F1/R@2 by 11.7\%/11.6\%/22.6\% on HAR, increases zero-shot IMU-to-text and text-to-IMU retrieval MRR by 15.9\% and 28.6\%, respectively, and improves zero-shot captioning BERT-F1 by 18.8\%. These results support AnyMo as a generalist model for wearable motion understanding in the wild. Project page: https://baiyuchen.com/project/AnyMo.

AI.tldr: AnyMo是一个几何感知框架，通过物理模拟生成多样化的IMU信号，结合图编码器和大语言模型，实现与设备设置无关的人体运动建模，在零样本活动识别、跨模态检索和运动描述三项任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备的IMU信号高度依赖传感设置（身体位置、安装方式、传感器朝向、硬件和采样协议），导致运动表征难以跨设备和数据集迁移，限制了其在封闭识别外的广泛应用。
AI.method: 1）基于物理的IMU模拟，在密集身体表面位置生成多样化合成信号；2）利用配对合成视图和掩码部分观测预训练图编码器；3）将多位置IMU信号标记化为全身运动token；4）将这些token与大语言模型对齐以进行运动-语言理解。
AI.result: 在14个未见过的下游数据集上：HAR任务Accuracy/F1/R@2平均提升11.7%/11.6%/22.6%；零样本IMU到文本和文本到IMU检索MRR分别提升15.9%和28.6%；零样本描述BERT-F1提升18.8%。
AI.conclusion: AnyMo可作为通用模型用于野外可穿戴运动理解，解决了传感设置依赖问题，实现了跨设备和数据集的有效迁移。

title: MuKV: Multi-Grained KV Cache Compression for Long Streaming Video Question-Answering
comment: To appear at CVPR'26. Code is available at https://github.com/IMBALDY/MuKV
summary: Long streaming video QA remains challenging due to growing visual tokens and limited reasoning length of large language models (LLMs). KV-caching stores the Key-Value (KV) of the historical tokens via LLM prefill and enables more efficient streaming QA. However, existing methods cache every one or two frames, causing redundant memory usage and losing fine-grained spatial details within frame or temporal contexts across frames. This paper proposes MuKV, a method that features a multi-grained KV cache compression module and a semi-hierarchical retrieval approach to improve both efficiency and accuracy for long streaming VideoQA. For the offline KV cache, MuKV extracts visual representations at patch-, frame-, and segment-levels. The multiple levels of granularity preserve both local cues and global temporal context, while maintaining efficiency with a dual signal token compression mechanism guided by self-attention and frequency. For online QA, MuKV designs a semi-hierarchical retrieval method to retrieve relevant KV caches for answer generation. Experiments on long-streaming VideoQA benchmarks show that MuKV significantly improves answer accuracy, without sacrificing memory and online QA efficiency. Moreover, our compression mechanism alone brings consistent benefits across answer accuracy, memory, and QA efficiency over baselines, showcasing highly effective contribution.

AI.tldr: MuKV提出了一种多粒度KV缓存压缩模块和半分层检索方法，在不牺牲内存和效率的前提下，显著提升了长流式视频问答的精度。
AI.motivation: 长流式视频QA中，现有KV缓存方法每1-2帧缓存一次，导致内存冗余，且丢失帧内细粒度空间细节和帧间时序上下文。
AI.method: MuKV包含两部分：1) 离线KV缓存：在patch、frame、segment三个粒度提取视觉表示，并通过自注意力与频率引导的双信号令牌压缩机制保持效率；2) 在线QA：设计半分层检索方法，检索相关KV缓存用于答案生成。
AI.result: 在长流式VideoQA基准上，MuKV显著提升了答案精度，同时未牺牲内存和在线QA效率；压缩机制本身在精度、内存和效率上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度KV缓存压缩和半分层检索可有效平衡长视频QA中的效率与精度，且压缩模块本身具有广泛的适用性。

title: Exposing Vulnerabilities in Visible-Infrared VLMs: A Unified Geometric Adversarial Framework with Cross-Task Transferability
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse multimodal tasks, but their adversarial robustness in visible-infrared (VIS-IR) scenarios remains underexplored. This gap is critical because VIS-IR sensing is widely used in real-world perception systems to support reliable understanding under challenging imaging conditions. To address this cross-modal threat setting, we propose CFGPatch, a curved-edge fractal geometric adversarial patch framework for attacking VIS-IR VLMs. CFGPatch builds on triangular fractal geometry and replaces rigid straight-edged primitives with Bezier-curved elements, preserving multi-scale fractal self-similarity while introducing smoother contours, richer directional variation, and more flexible shape deformation. In addition, we design a modality-specific Fraser-spiral rendering mechanism to inject fine-grained texture distortions and misleading perceptual cues into visible and infrared images. By coupling global curved-fractal geometry with local spiral-based appearance interference, CFGPatch disrupts both shape perception and texture interpretation. We further adopt expectation over transformation (EOT) to improve robustness against common image-level transformations. Extensive experiments show that CFGPatch effectively fools VIS-IR VLMs and consistently outperforms standard patch baselines in attack effectiveness and robustness. Moreover, adversarial samples optimized for zero-shot classification transfer well to image captioning and visual question answering, demonstrating strong cross-task transferability and generalizability across downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CFGPatch，一种基于曲线分形几何的对抗性补丁框架，用于攻击可见光-红外视觉语言模型，在跨模态场景下显著优于传统补丁方法。
AI.motivation: 可见光-红外感知系统在现实中被广泛使用，但现有视觉语言模型的对抗鲁棒性在VIS-IR跨模态场景下尚未被充分探索，存在关键安全空白。
AI.method: 采用贝塞尔曲线替代直线棱边构建三角形分形几何补丁，引入模态特定的Fraser螺旋渲染机制注入纹理失真，并结合期望变换（EOT）增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: CFGPatch在攻击VIS-IR视觉语言模型时效果显著，优于标准补丁基线；对抗样本在零样本分类、图像描述和视觉问答等下游任务中表现出强跨任务迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 曲线分形几何与局部纹理干扰的耦合能有效破坏模型形状感知与纹理解释，为跨模态对抗攻击提供了新范式。

title: PIU: Proximity-guided Identity Unlearning in ID-Conditioned Diffusion Models
summary: Identity-conditioned diffusion models enable high-quality and identity-consistent face generation, but they also raise severe privacy concerns, as models may continue to synthesize individuals despite their right to be forgotten. While machine unlearning has been extensively studied for concept and data removal, identity unlearning remains largely unexplored, particularly in models conditioned directly on identity embeddings rather than text prompts. In this work, we study identity unlearning in Arc2Face, a state-of-the-art identity-conditioned latent diffusion model for face generation, and introduce Proximity-guided Identity Unlearning (PIU), an anchor-guided framework for identity unlearning. Specifically, we formulate identity removal as an identity replacement objective that reassigns the source identity to a selected anchor identity in the learned identity space, and we complement it with a proximity-based anchor selection strategy motivated by the geometry of ArcFace representations. We further show that effective unlearning can be achieved through localized fine-tuning of a small subset of identity-sensitive cross-attention layers. Experiments across many target identities show that our framework effectively suppresses generation of the target identity while preserving realism and identity consistency for retained identities, as validated by improved performance on unlearning and image-quality metrics, together with qualitative evaluation. The source code for the PIU framework is publicly available at https://github.com/edgarcancinoe/piu_unlearning .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向身份条件扩散模型的身份遗忘框架PIU，通过锚点引导的身份替换和局部微调策略，有效抑制目标身份生成同时保持其他身份的一致性与图像质量。
AI.motivation: 身份条件扩散模型在生成高质量人脸时存在隐私隐患（如违反"被遗忘权"），而现有机器遗忘研究多关注概念或数据删除，缺乏对身份遗忘的探索，尤其缺乏针对身份嵌入条件模型的研究。
AI.method: 提出Proximity-guided Identity Unlearning (PIU)框架：1）将身份移除转化为身份替换目标，在嵌入空间中将源身份重分配给选定的锚点身份；2）基于ArcFace表征几何特性设计近邻锚点选择策略；3）仅对少量身份敏感交叉注意力层进行局部微调实现有效遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个目标身份上的实验表明，PIU有效抑制了目标身份生成，同时在保留身份的真实性和一致性上表现优异，遗忘指标和图像质量指标均有提升，定性评估也验证了效果。
AI.conclusion: PIU框架能够高效实现身份条件扩散模型中的身份遗忘，为隐私保护提供了可行方案，代码已开源。

title: Robustness of breast lesion segmentation under MRI undersampling improves with k-space-aware deep learning
summary:
Purpose: To assess whether breast lesion segmentation can be learned directly from acquired MRI k-space, and whether doing so improves robustness when data are accelerated or noisy.
  Materials and Methods: This retrospective study used public breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI) datasets with acquired and synthetic k-space, together with a within-dataset synthetic control. We compared four 3D U-Net variants: a hybrid k-space-to-image model, a native k-space model, and magnitude and complex image-space baselines. Models were evaluated under increasing undersampling and added complex Gaussian k-space noise. The primary outcome was patient-level Dice similarity coefficient under cross-validation, with the hybrid model prespecified as the main comparison against the magnitude image-space baseline.
  Results: At full sampling, the hybrid and image-space models performed similarly. As acceleration increased, the hybrid model retained substantially more segmentation accuracy and significantly outperformed the magnitude image-space baseline across moderate to high undersampling levels. The same pattern was observed when noise was added directly to k-space: the hybrid model degraded more slowly, whereas the image-space baseline failed under heavier noise. This advantage was reproduced in the within-dataset synthetic control. Feature analysis suggested that the k-space stage and image-space stage played complementary roles, with frequency-domain filtering concentrated before image-domain lesion localization.
  Conclusion: K-space-aware deep learning improves the robustness of breast lesion segmentation under MRI undersampling and k-space noise, while matching image-space methods at full sampling.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合k空间和图像空间的混合3D U-Net模型用于乳腺病变分割，在完整采样时与图像空间模型性能相当，但在欠采样和噪声条件下显著更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 探索是否可以直接从MRI采集的k空间学习乳腺病变分割，并验证这样做能否提高在数据加速或噪声条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 使用公开乳腺DCE-MRI数据集，比较四种3D U-Net变体：混合k空间-图像模型、原生k空间模型、幅度和复数图像空间基线。在递增欠采样和添加k空间复高斯噪声条件下评估，主要指标为患者级别Dice相似系数。
AI.result: 完整采样时混合模型与图像空间模型性能相似；随加速增加，混合模型保持更多分割精度，在中高欠采样水平显著优于幅度图像空间基线；噪声条件下混合模型退化更慢，图像空间基线在重噪声下失效；特征分析表明k空间和图像空间阶段起互补作用。
AI.conclusion: k空间感知的深度学习在MRI欠采样和k空间噪声下提高了乳腺病变分割的鲁棒性，同时在完整采样时匹配图像空间方法的表现。

title: 4D-GSW: Kinematic-Aware Spatio-Temporal Consistent Watermarking for 4D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 9 pages main paper, 7 figures, 18 pages in total
summary: While 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has revolutionized high-fidelity dynamic reconstruction, safeguarding the intellectual property of these assets remains an open challenge. Conventional steganographic techniques often neglect the underlying kinematic manifolds, triggering non-physical artifacts such as severe temporal flickering and "FVD collapse". To address this, we propose \textbf{4D-GSW}, a kinematic-aware watermarking framework designed to embed robust copyright information while preserving high spatio-temporal consistency. Unlike prior 4D steganography that primarily focuses on opacity-guided invisibility, our approach explicitly addresses the physical coherence of motion trajectories. We introduce a \textbf{Spatio-Temporal Curvature (STC)} metric to identify "Dynamic Instants," adaptively gating watermark gradient injection to shield critical motion manifolds from non-physical perturbations. To ensure global coherence across complex deformations, we formulate a joint \textbf{HMM-MRF energy minimization} model that synchronizes watermark phases within both temporal trajectories and spatial neighborhoods. Furthermore, an \textbf{anisotropic gradient routing} mechanism ensures that watermark embedding remains strictly decoupled from photometric reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the superior performance of our method in robustly hiding watermarks while resisting various attacks and maintaining high rendering quality and spatiotemporal consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出4D-GSW，一种运动感知的水印框架，在4D高斯泼溅动态场景中嵌入版权信息，同时保持时空一致性，避免传统方法导致的闪烁和FVD崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）在高保真动态重建方面取得突破，但其知识产权保护仍是挑战。传统隐写技术忽略底层运动流形，导致非物理伪影（如严重的时间闪烁和FVD崩溃），亟需一种兼顾鲁棒水印与高时空一致性的方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出时空曲率（STC）指标识别"动态瞬间"，自适应门控水印梯度注入以保护关键运动流形；2) 构建联合HMM-MRF能量最小化模型，同步水印相位于时间轨迹和空间邻域；3) 引入各向异性梯度路由机制，确保水印嵌入与光度重建保真度严格解耦。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在鲁棒隐藏水印、抵抗多种攻击的同时，保持了高渲染质量和时空一致性，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 4D-GSW通过显式建模运动物理一致性，实现了动态场景下鲁棒水印嵌入与高质量渲染的平衡，为4D资产版权保护提供了有效方案。

title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Building on this idea, we propose Bernini, a unified framework for video generation and editing. An MLLM-based planner predicts the target semantic representation directly in the ViT embedding space, and a DiT-based renderer synthesizes pixels conditioned on this plan, augmented by text features and, for editing, source VAE features for detail preservation. Because semantics serve as the interface, the planner and renderer can be trained separately and only lightly co-trained, preserving the pretrained strengths of both components while keeping training efficient. To better handle multiple visual inputs, we introduce Segment-Aware 3D Rotary Positional Embedding (SA-3D RoPE), and further incorporate chain-of-thought reasoning in the planner to better transfer understanding into generation. Bernini achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of video generation and editing benchmarks, with the MLLM's pretrained understanding translating into strong generalization on challenging editing tasks.

AI.tldr: Bernini是一个统一视频生成与编辑框架，通过MLLM进行语义规划、扩散模型进行像素渲染的分工协作，在多项基准上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: MLLM擅长多模态语义理解与推理，扩散模型擅长高保真图像合成，但两者各自独立发展。作者认为可以通过明确分工将两类模型统一，实现优势互补。
AI.method: 提出Bernini框架：(1) MLLM规划器在ViT嵌入空间中预测目标语义表示；(2) DiT渲染器根据语义计划、文本特征（编辑时还包含源VAE特征）合成像素；(3) 规划器和渲染器可分开训练，仅需少量联合训练；(4) 引入SA-3D RoPE处理多视觉输入；(5) 在规划器中融入链式思维推理增强理解到生成的迁移能力。
AI.result: 在多个视频生成与编辑基准测试中达到最先进水平，MLLM的预训练理解能力有效泛化到具有挑战性的编辑任务上。
AI.conclusion: 通过MLLM与扩散模型的明确分工（语义规划+像素渲染），可以构建统一且高效的高质量视频生成与编辑框架，且训练效率高、泛化能力强。

title: QuantSR+: Pushing the Limit of Quantized Image Super-Resolution Networks
summary: Low-bit quantization is widely used to compress super-resolution (SR) models and reduce storage and computation costs for deployment on resource-limited devices. However, when SR models are pushed to ultra-low precision (2-4 bits), performance can drop sharply due to diminished representational capacity and the detail-sensitive nature of SR. To address these issues, we propose QuantSR+, a unified framework that improves quantization operators, network design, and training optimization, achieving better trade-offs between accuracy and efficiency than prior low-bit SR methods. QuantSR+ mainly relies on three technical contributions: (1) Redistribution-driven Bit Determination (RBD), which reshapes quantization distributions in both forward and backward passes to preserve representation fidelity; (2) Quantized Slimmable Architecture (QSA), which begins with an over-parameterized model and progressively prunes less critical blocks to meet efficiency budgets while pushing the accuracy performance; and (3) Slimming-guided Function-localized Distillation (SFD), which enforces block-aware feature alignment via a direct loss and a progressive, function-local training schedule to capture quantization effects better and speed up convergence. Extensive experiments show that QuantSR+ achieves state-of-the-art performance against both specialized quantized SR methods and generic quantization approaches. For SwinIR-S on Urban100 (x4), it improves PSNR by 0.29 dB over the 2-bit SOTA baseline. Meanwhile, it delivers strong efficiency gains at 2-bit, reducing operations by up to 87.9% and storage by 89.4%. QuantSR+ is effective for both convolutional and transformer-based SR models, indicating broad applicability.

AI.tldr: 提出QuantSR+框架，通过重分布驱动位确定(RBD)、量化可精简架构(QSA)和精简引导功能定位蒸馏(SFD)三种技术，在2-4位超低精度下显著提升超分辨率模型性能，实现精度与效率的更好权衡。
AI.motivation: 超分辨率模型在低比特量化（2-4位）时，由于表征能力下降和SR任务对细节敏感的特性，性能严重下降，现有方法难以在超低精度下兼顾精度与效率。
AI.method: (1) RBD：在前向和反向传播中重塑量化分布以保真表征；(2) QSA：从过参数化模型起步，渐进剪枝不关键模块以匹配效率预算；(3) SFD：通过块级特征对齐的直接损失和渐进式功能定位训练策略，加速收敛并捕捉量化效应。
AI.result: SwinIR-S在Urban100(x4)上2位SOTA提升0.29dB PSNR；2位下运算量减少87.9%，存储减少89.4%；适用于CNN和Transformer两类SR模型。
AI.conclusion: QuantSR+在超低精度量化SR任务上达到SOTA，兼具广适性和高效性。

title: GazePrior: Zero-Shot AR/VR Eye Tracking via Learned 3D Gaze Reconstruction
summary: Eye tracking (ET) is a foundational technology for advanced AR/VR applications. However, training ET models for every new ET device is challenging: real data collection is costly and time-consuming, while existing synthetic data generation methods lack realism. To remove the need for additional data collection while maintaining data quality, we introduce a data-driven 3D prior that models the distribution of human eyes across diverse identities, gaze directions, and light settings. This model, which we coin GazePrior, then enables sparse-input 3D reconstruction of annotated data collected with previous ET devices, which can in turn be rendered from the cameras of any target ET device. Our approach synthesizes data with the realism, diversity and ground-truth accuracy of real data collection without its prohibitive costs. Our experiments demonstrate that ET models trained with our synthesized data outperform previous zero-shot methods, achieving higher accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GazePrior，一种数据驱动的3D先验模型，用于生成高质量合成数据训练眼动追踪模型，无需额外真实数据采集，在AR/VR应用中表现优于现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 眼动追踪是AR/VR的基础技术，但为每个新设备训练ET模型面临挑战：真实数据采集成本高、耗时长，而现有合成数据方法缺乏真实感。需要一种无需额外数据采集同时保持数据质量的方法。
AI.method: 提出GazePrior——数据驱动的3D先验模型，建模不同身份、注视方向和光照条件下人类眼睛的分布。利用该先验对先前ET设备采集的标注数据进行稀疏输入3D重建，再从任意目标ET设备的相机视角渲染合成数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用合成数据训练的ET模型在准确性和鲁棒性上均优于先前零样本方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能以真实数据采集的保真度、多样性和标注精度合成数据，同时避免高昂成本，为跨设备眼动追踪提供高效解决方案。

title: AgroTools: A Benchmark for Tool-Augmented Multimodal Agents in Agriculture
summary: Agricultural decision-making increasingly requires multimodal systems that can transform visual observations into reliable, executable actions. However, existing agricultural multimodal benchmarks mainly evaluate final-answer correctness and provide limited support for assessing whether models can use external tools to complete precision-sensitive workflows. In this paper, we introduce AgroTools, a benchmark for evaluating tool-augmented multimodal agents in agriculture. AgroTools contains 539 question-answer instances paired with 1,097 heterogeneous agricultural images, spanning five task families and an executable environment of 14 agricultural tools. Each query is annotated with structured tool-use traces, enabling a dual-view evaluation of both process-level execution quality and outcome-level task success. We benchmark 9 open-source and 4 closed-source multimodal large language models on AgroTools. Results show that current models remain far from reliable in agricultural tool-use settings, with clear bottlenecks in tool planning, argument generation, execution recovery, and final-answer synthesis. We hope AgroTools will support future research on multimodal agents for high-precision agricultural applications. The benchmark and evaluation are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/AgroTools/AgroTools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgroTools基准，用于评估农业场景中工具增强的多模态智能体，包含539个问答实例、1097张图像、14种农业工具，支持从过程执行质量和结果任务成功率两个维度进行评估。实验发现当前多模态大模型在农业工具使用方面仍不可靠，存在规划、参数生成、执行恢复和答案合成等多方面瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有农业多模态基准主要评估最终答案的正确性，缺乏对模型能否使用外部工具完成精度敏感工作流的评估能力。
AI.method: 构建包含539个问答实例、1097张异构农业图像、5个任务家族和14种农业工具的基准AgroTools，每个查询都标注了结构化的工具使用轨迹，支持过程级执行质量和结果级任务成功的双视角评估。
AI.result: 对9个开源和4个闭源多模态大模型进行了基准测试，结果显示当前模型在农业工具使用场景中远不可靠，在工具规划、参数生成、执行恢复和最终答案合成方面存在明确瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: AgroTools有望支持未来面向高精度农业应用的多模态智能体研究，基准和评估代码已开源。

title: Translating Signals to Languages for sEMG-Based Activity Recognition
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) signal-based activity recognition has attracted increasing research attention in recent years. To develop accurate sEMG signal-based activity recognizers, numerous approaches have been proposed. Some studies focus on designing larger and more expressive model architectures to enhance the representational capacity of sEMG signals, while others aim to enrich model priors through large-scale pretraining, thereby improving recognition performance. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable generalization and reasoning capabilities in natural language processing, whose implicit knowledge, learned from extensive linguistic descriptions of actions, opens new possibilities for interpreting sEMG signals and inferring activity intentions. Motivated by this, we propose LLM-sEMG, a novel framework that leverages LLMs as sEMG activity recognizers. Within this framework, we design a language-oriented mapping mechanism that converts continuous sEMG sequences into sEMG language, integrating several strategies to further facilitate the signal-to-language mapping process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves highly accurate sEMG signal-based activity recognition using large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-sEMG框架，通过将连续sEMG信号映射为"sEMG语言"，利用大语言模型（LLM）进行活动识别，实验证明该方法实现了高精度识别。
AI.motivation: 现有sEMG活动识别方法主要依赖设计更大的模型架构或大规模预训练，而大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言处理中展现出的泛化与推理能力，为从sEMG信号中推断活动意图提供了新的可能性。
AI.method: 提出LLM-sEMG框架，设计语言导向的映射机制将连续sEMG序列转换为"sEMG语言"，并集成多种策略以促进信号到语言的映射过程，最终利用LLM进行活动识别。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的框架能够利用大语言模型实现高精度的sEMG信号活动识别。
AI.conclusion: LLM-sEMG框架有效结合了大语言模型的隐式知识与sEMG信号处理，为基于表面肌电信号的活动识别提供了一种新范式。

title: The Neglected Baseline in Model Interpretation
summary: We observe that existing model interpretation methods generally ignore the baseline, and such neglect often results in imprecise or even incorrect interpretation. In this paper, we reformulate the task of model interpretation and the interpretation principles for model interpretation results to demonstrate the importance of the baseline. We further unify gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) methods, and Taylor expansion, clarifying the connections among them and explicitly identifying the baseline for each method. On this basis, we analyze the flaws and errors in related model interpretation methods (IG, LayerCAM, ODAM, Difference Map). We advocate evaluating the quality of model interpretation results precisely through the attribution error between the attribution result and the attribution target, rather than adopting flawed evaluation methods, such as those based on marginal-effect or the assumption of perfect model performance. We revise IG and develope a model interpretation method with a clear and reasonable baseline, achieving better results. Our method supports model interpretation based on features from any layer. Interpretation based on features from different layers are all reasonable, and the differences among these results reflect varying degrees of feature extraction at different feature extraction stages.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线（baseline）的问题，重新定义了解释任务与原则，统一了梯度法、积分梯度（IG）和泰勒展开等方法，明确了各方法的基线。在此基础上分析了IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法的缺陷，提出用归因误差替代有缺陷的评估方法，并开发了基于清晰合理基线的改进IG方法，支持任意层的特征解释。
AI.motivation: 现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线（baseline），导致解释结果不精确甚至错误。作者希望通过重新审视基线的重要性，统一现有方法并修正其缺陷。
AI.method: 重新定义模型解释任务与原则；统一梯度法、积分梯度（IG）和泰勒展开，明确各方法的基线；分析IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map的缺陷；提出用归因误差替代基于边际效应或完美模型假设的评估方法；开发基于清晰合理基线的改进IG方法，支持任意层特征解释。
AI.result: 改进后的IG方法在基线设定上更清晰合理，取得了更好的解释效果；不同层的解释结果均合理，且差异反映不同特征提取阶段的程度。
AI.conclusion: 基线对于模型解释至关重要，忽略基线会导致解释偏差；统一框架有助于厘清方法间的联系与不足；基于归因误差的评估方法更可靠；所提改进方法在解释质量和灵活性上表现更优。

title: FastTab: A Fast Table Recognizer with a Tiny Recursive Module and 1D Transformers
summary: Table structure recognition (TSR) requires both table-level coherence (row/column counts, headers, spanning cells) and precise separator localization. We introduce FastTab, a grid-centric TSR model that avoids autoregressive HTML decoding by combining (i) a lightweight Tiny Recursive Module (TRM) for global reasoning and (ii) axial 1D Transformer encoders that capture long-range dependencies along rows and columns. The model predicts row/column counts, header rows, and separators to construct a grid, then infers rowspan/colspan using ROI-aligned cell features. Across four benchmarks (PubTabNet, FinTabNet, PubTables-1M, and SciTSR), FastTab achieves competitive structure recovery performance while operating at low-latency inference. We further study robustness under pixel-level anonymisation and show an extension to curved separators for camera-captured documents. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/hamdilaziz/FastTab .

AI.tldr: FastTab是一种基于网格的表格结构识别模型，通过轻量级TRM模块和轴向1D Transformer编码器，在多个基准上实现高效且精确的表格结构恢复，支持低延迟推理。
AI.motivation: 现有TSR方法通常依赖自回归HTML解码，效率低下且难以同时保证表格级连贯性和精确的分隔符定位。
AI.method: 结合轻量级Tiny Recursive Module (TRM) 进行全局推理，以及轴向1D Transformer编码器捕获行列长距离依赖，预测行列数、表头、分隔符构建网格，并通过ROI对齐的单元格特征推断跨行/跨列。
AI.result: 在PubTabNet、FinTabNet、PubTables-1M和SciTSR四个基准上取得了具有竞争力的结构恢复性能，同时实现低延迟推理。
AI.conclusion: FastTab在效率和精度之间取得了良好平衡，支持像素级匿名化鲁棒性和弯曲分隔符扩展，适用于多种文档场景。

title: Moment-Reenacting: Inverse Motion Degradation with Cross-shutter Guidance
summary: Motion degradation, manifested as blur in global shutter (GS) images or rolling shutter (RS) distortion in RS counterparts, remains a fundamental challenge in computational imaging, especially under fast motion or low-light conditions. While prior works have treated blur decomposition and RS temporal super-resolution as separate tasks, this separation fails to exploit their intrinsic complementarity. In this paper, we propose a unified framework to invert motion degradation and reenact imaging moment by jointly leveraging the complementary characteristics of GS blur and RS distortion. To this end, we introduce a novel dual-shutter setup that captures synchronized blur-RS image pairs and demonstrate that this combination effectively resolves temporal and spatial ambiguities inherent in both modalities. For allowing flexible performance-cost trade-offs, we further extend this dual-shutter setup to a stereo Blur-RS configuration with a narrow baseline. In addition, we construct a triaxial imaging system to collect a real-world dataset with aligned GS-RS pairs and ground-truth high-speed frames, enabling robust training and evaluation beyond synthetic data. Our proposed network explicitly disentangles motion into context-aware and temporally-sensitive representations via a dual-stream motion interpretation module, followed by a self-prompted frame reconstruction stage. Extensive experiments validate the superiority and generalizability of our approach, establishing a new paradigm for realistic high-speed video reconstruction under complex motion degradations. Codes and more resources are available at https://jixiang2016.github.io/dualBR_site/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一框架，通过联合利用全局快门模糊和卷帘快门畸变的互补特性，实现运动退化逆推和高速视频重建，并构建了双快门数据集和网络模型。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将模糊分解和RS时间超分作为独立任务处理，未能利用两者内在的互补性，导致在复杂运动退化场景下效果受限。
AI.method: 提出双快门（全局快门+卷帘快门）同步采集设置，扩展为窄基线立体Blur-RS配置；构建三轴成像系统采集真实世界数据集；设计双流运动解释模块解耦运动，结合自提示帧重建网络。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了该方法在复杂运动退化下的优越性和泛化能力，建立了高速视频重建的新范式。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合利用GS模糊和RS畸变的互补特性，该统一框架有效解决了时空模糊性，实现了更真实的高速视频重建。

title: Pre-VLA: Preemptive Runtime Verification for Reliable Vision-Language-Action and World-Model Rollouts
summary: While large vision-language-action (VLA) models and generative world models (WM) have advanced long-horizon embodied intelligence, their practical deployment remains challenged by uncertainty in learning-based action generation. Low-quality actions may cause physical failures during execution or lead to misleading world-model rollouts with redundant rendering costs. To address this issue, we propose Pre-VLA, a unified runtime verification architecture that performs preemptive action validity assessment before physical execution or world-model imagination. Pre-VLA leverages an efficient multimodal backbone with modality-aware pooling and a lightweight dual-branch head to predict both safety confidence and critic-derived advantage scores for candidate action chunks. To handle severe class imbalance and unstable boundary decisions, we train Pre-VLA with a multi-task objective combining Focal classification, advantage regression, and soft-threshold calibration. During deployment, a dual-mode preemptive resampling scheduler filters low-quality actions and triggers adaptive resampling under a limited computation budget. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark show that Pre-VLA improves the average closed-loop success rate across four suites from 30.79\% to 37.62\% over RynnVLA-002, reduces task execution steps, achieves 183.9 ms average forward verification time per action chunk, and mitigates error accumulation in world-model rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出Pre-VLA，一种运行时验证架构，在物理执行或世界模型推演前预判动作质量，通过多模态骨干网络和轻量级双分支头预测安全置信度和优势分数，结合自适应重采样调度器过滤低质量动作，在LIBERO基准上将闭环成功率从30.79%提升至37.62%。
AI.motivation: 大视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型和生成式世界模型(WM)在长程具身智能中面临挑战：基于学习的动作生成存在不确定性，低质量动作可能导致物理执行故障或世界模型推演中的冗余渲染成本与错误累积。
AI.method: 1) 高效多模态骨干网络，包含模态感知池化；2) 轻量级双分支头，分别预测安全置信度和基于评论家的优势分数；3) 多任务训练目标，结合Focal分类、优势回归和软阈值校准；4) 双模式预emptive重采样调度器，在有限计算预算下过滤低质量动作并触发自适应重采样。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，将RynnVLA-002的平均闭环成功率从30.79%提升至37.62%，减少了任务执行步骤，每个动作块平均前向验证时间为183.9毫秒，并缓解了世界模型推演中的错误累积。
AI.conclusion: Pre-VLA通过运行时预判动作有效性，有效提升了VLA模型在执行和世界模型规划中的鲁棒性和效率，验证了轻量级验证架构在具身智能系统中的实用价值。

title: MaSC: A Masked Similarity Metric for Evaluating Concept-Driven Generation
summary: Evaluating single-concept personalization in text-to-image diffusion requires measuring both concept preservation, which captures identity fidelity to a reference, and prompt following, which captures whether the generated scene matches the prompt. Existing metrics commonly compute these signals using global image or text-image embeddings, such as CLIP-I, DINO, and CLIP-T.
